purpose: Represent explicit source/account/period coverage for Cash opening balance, movement events and observed ending balance without changing source provenance or Financial Truth quality.

scope.branch: explicit branch or ALL only when aggregate_proven=true
scope.channel: explicit channel or ALL only when aggregate_proven=true

shape.as_of: max valid privacy-safe upstream as-of supplied by caller

complete_rules: Aggregate COMPLETE is impossible unless account_universe.universe_proven=true.
Known source presence, row presence or mapper coverage_hint cannot prove COMPLETE.
An empty required universe is MISSING unless empty_universe_proven=true with privacy-safe lineage and compatible target scope/period.
Every required source/account universe member must be explicitly covered or explicitly represented by a proven aggregate source.
A required NOT_CONNECTED source blocks COMPLETE and sets required_not_connected=true.
Coverage COMPLETE never upgrades Financial Truth quality, balance basis, mapper classification or cash-event quality.
movement_rules: MOVEMENT_EVENTS COMPLETE requires every required source to have coverage_proven=true and interval union covering the full target period.
Multiple intervals for one source may be merged only when overlapping or contiguous.
Any gap in required-source interval coverage prevents COMPLETE.
Intervals outside the target period do not count.
Sparse transaction rows do not imply missing dates are covered.
Unknown universe can be PARTIAL when useful bounded evidence exists, otherwise MISSING.
point_rules: OPENING_BALANCE coverage is a target-start point rule, not interval coverage.
OBSERVED_ENDING_BALANCE coverage is a target-end point rule, not interval coverage.
OPENING_BALANCE may accept a valid canonical COMPUTED_BALANCE opening while preserving computed provenance and Financial Truth quality.
OBSERVED_ENDING_BALANCE requires a valid canonical OBSERVED_BALANCE wrapper.
Computed remainder can never satisfy observed ending coverage.
Current point evidence cannot satisfy a historical target point.
account_rules: A source/account entry covers only its explicit account and branch/channel scope.
Account label ALL requires separate account aggregate proof.
Enterprise COMPLETE requires a proven account/source universe and proven aggregate scope; one branch/account never silently proves ALL.
Identical stable coverage entries may dedupe; conflicting duplicates fail closed.
privacy_rules: Source class, logical account label and lineage must be privacy-safe.
Account numbers, wallet IDs, Drive URLs/IDs, tokens and raw private notes are forbidden.
Public outputs contain no raw financial amount.
cash_bridge_compatibility: Only MOVEMENT_EVENTS coverage can be converted to Cash Bridge event coverage.
Adapter output shape is exactly status, source_coverage, as_of and lineage.
OPENING_BALANCE and OBSERVED_ENDING_BALANCE coverage remain separate from event coverage.
Cash Bridge arithmetic is unchanged by TASK-063.
